The itinerary's 5,000 is correct.

results.evidence: dist_km 9.3 (5.8 mi) is shown as one-way, but the itinerary gives 5.8 mi as the ROUND TRIP and the summit waypoint sits at 2.9 mi. A south-side report gives 10.5 mi round trip (about 5.25 mi one way). The row's own corrections cite the same 10.5 mi figure, so it is one source; not enough to settle the one-way distance.

results.fact: Trailhead (road end at Hannegan Campground vs milepost-3 pullout)
results.evidence: The only detailed report of this route (published twice by the same author) parks at a wide spot about 3 miles up the Hannegan Pass Road, just past a creek flowing over a concrete weir (~2,950 ft), and drops straight to Ruth Creek. This supports the milepost-3 start in approach_variants. No second independent source was found. The road end at Hannegan Campground is ~3,100 ft (5,100 ft pass minus 2,000 ft gain; 3,100 ft gain to a 6,200 ft high point), so the row's '~2,950 ft' matches the pullout, not the road end. Recommend moving the start to the pullout once a second source confirms it.

Two sources put the Hannegan road-end trailhead at ~3,100 ft (a 4-mile trail gaining 2,000 ft to the 5,100 ft pass; a hike page giving 3,100 ft gain to 6,200 ft). So '~2,950 ft' is wrong for the road end but right for the milepost-3 pullout. Which figure belongs depends on the unresolved trailhead question, so there is no patch yet; bivy[0].elev 3100 is correct for the road end.
